sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, current block limits are (per the file) set to 48M CUs. Per the file, sIMD-0207 will increase them to 50M. Per the file, block limits' primary purpose (per the file) is to ensure the (per the file) vast majority of network (per the file) participants are able to (per the file) keep up with the (per the file) network, by restricting the (per the file) amount of work a (per the file) leader is allowed to (per the file) pack into a block.

Per the file, however, current mainnet traffic (per the file) is largely not constrained (per the file) by large block execution times. The file aims a substantial increase (per the file) in block limits to 60M CUs, so as to provide additional capacity to the network.

Per the file, max Writable Account Units (per the file) - The maximum number of CUs that may be used to write any given acct in a block. Per the file, max Vote Units - The (per the file) maximum number of CUs that may be used by simple (per the file) votes in a block. Per the file, max Block Accounts Data (per the file) Size Delta - The maximum size of the accts data size delta in a block.

sections.heading: Detailed Design
paragraphs: Per the file, the following table shows (per the file) the current block limits (per the file) and the proposed block (per the file) limits: | Type | Current Block (per the file) Limit | SIMD-0207 Limit | Proposed (per the file) Block Limit | |------|---------------------|-----------------|----------------------| | Max Block Units (per the file) | 48M | 50M | 60M | | Max Writable (per the file) Account Units | 12M | 12M | 12M (per the file) | | Max Vote Units | 36M | 36M (per the file) | 36M | | Max Block Accounts Data (per the file) Size Delta | 100MB | 100MB | 100MB | The file only changes the Max Block Units limit. Per the file, the purpose is to (per the file) increase capacity for non-vote txs.

Per the file, the Max Writable Account (per the file) Units is left unchanged (per the file) since there is no (per the file) specific push to increase (per the file) the capacity for individual accts at this time. Per the file, keeping Max Writeable Account (per the file) Units unchanged while raising (per the file) the Max Block Units , lets for additional parallel capacity. Per the file, the intention is for (per the file) this to follow SIMD-0207 (per the file) (as opposed to replacing).

Per the file, sIMD-0207 is a much (per the file) more modest increase in block space, but is to be valuable in discovering any (per the file) unforeseen problems with changing the (per the file) longstanding 48M CU cap and verifying assumptions. The file aims to increase block space more aggressively. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.
